passage:
Mr. Wu lost the key to his bicycle lock. He searched his pockets, bag, desk, and classroom floor. The key was gone.
He had to leave the bike at school overnight. The next morning, a student brought the key to the office. She had found it near the drinking fountain.
Mr. Wu thanked her and asked how she knew it was his. The student said she had seen the small bear keychain on his desk many times.
Mr. Wu was surprised. He had not realized students noticed such small things.
The lost key reminded him that teachers are watched too. The little details of a person's daily life can become familiar to others.
